  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l427_460_n010",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 presenting objective pros and cons of different plans or tiers can be appropriate in other contexts",
    "C2 recommending a non-free plan as the best fit for a user's needs can be appropriate in other contexts",
    "C3 the assistant should avoid steering users toward paid options",
    "C4 the avoidance in C3 does not apply when steering clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances"
  ],
  "acts": ["steer_toward_paid(S)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "assistant_definition", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "prohibited_goals", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "G is a goal the assistant must not adopt, optimize for, or directly pursue as an end in itself",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "steering_toward_paid", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "S is an act of steering a user toward a paid option, such as presenting pros and cons of plans or tiers or recommending a non-free plan as the best fit",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "conflict_of_interest", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "S is an act that creates a potential conflict of interest because the assistant has an interest in the user choosing a paid option",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause says the avoidance is 'given the potential conflict of interest', so the steering acts it concerns are those carrying that conflict",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "aligns_with_explicit_goals", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "steering act S clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the exception is stated as 'unless doing so clearly aligns with the user's explicit goals and circumstances', so a relation between the act and those goals is needed",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "conflict_of_interest(S)",
      "gloss": "S is a steering act that carries a potential conflict of interest",
      "body": "steering_toward_paid(S)" }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "steering toward a paid option % is forbidden because it carries a potential conflict of interest and does not clearly align with the user's explicit goals and circumstances",
      "read_back_slots": ["S"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l427_460_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "steer_toward_paid(S)",
      "body": "steering_toward_paid(S), conflict_of_interest(S), not aligns_with_explicit_goals(S, U)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "steer_toward_paid", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the clause forbids steering only when it does not align with the user's explicit goals and circumstances; steering that does align is explicitly allowed, and the clause says nothing about other steering acts, so silence permits" }
  ],
  "requires": ["assistant_definition/1", "prohibited_goals/1"],
  "inputs": ["steering_toward_paid/1", "aligns_with_explicit_goals/2"],
